contract.atomicFactSet: Arca immutable用户Intent/完整preview proof + 当前Entry/Shelf/Canonical/Inventory/Standard/Placement/Control精确重验 + 独立Correction admitted/gate + Foundation Command Receipt/marker/audit；同Entry无其他nonterminal Correction/Care Case/active Off-deck Reservation；Control只读，不转移，不写旧On-deck/Libra/People/Perception事实，不产生Effect或Outbox；相同输入先重放Receipt，无Receipt才重验当前Basis
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Owner业务修改后响应前崩溃、相同key同payload重试、相同key不同payload重试
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Receipt与Owner修改同事务；同payload返回原result ref；不同payload稳定拒绝；不重复创建对象或推进revision

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: immutable preview validation, current Entry Basis, admission insert, Control read fence, Command Receipt/marker/audit, replay
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Admission and command facts are all present or all absent; stale Control or Entry rolls everything back; replay needs no cache and preserves old collection/Commit/bytes.
